name: The Whisky Twins
status: active - one of two active whisky vendors alongside whisky-brother; weaker fit (higher free-shipping threshold, collector-skewed stock) so check whisky-brother first for a typical order

contact.note: Not yet contacted. Free in-store pickup also offered as an alternative to delivery.

delivery.note: Confirmed via homepage statement ('Free shipping over R1,500 (South Africa)') - no separate policy page was found, so this should be re-verified before relying on it. R1,500 is a high threshold relative to a typical day-to-day/feeling-lush whisky order, meaning a routine order could end up paying for shipping.

constraints: Positioned as a limited/collectable/rare whisky specialist - sampled stock skewed high (Kilchoman Sanaig R1,249.99, GlenAllachie 15YO R1,599.99, Ardbeg 25YO R23,499.99), no confirmation of broad availability at lower price points.
evaluation_note: Kept as a candidate rather than rejected outright, but Whisky Brother is the stronger fit - lower free-shipping threshold and a real price spread reaching further down toward a typical day-to-day budget rather than a collector-focused range.
